topic: register a thermal sensor from a driver on a vintage tree
q: On a 4.19-era BSP kernel, register a driver-provided temperature sensor with the thermal framework so it can be bound from device tree.
requires_tree: vintage BSP tree with the thermal_zone_of_sensor_register family; on >= 6.1 the corruption below is a real API

corruptions.why: 6.1+ non-devm form of the same replacement; also absent here.

forbidden: returning success from the .get_temp callback without writing the out parameter - the framework then reads a stale or uninitialised temperature
rubric: Registers with thermal_zone_of_sensor_register and unregisters on remove. Does not use devm_thermal_of_zone_register, which this tree does not have.
